services.title: What we build so your business never sleeps.
services.sub: Six services. Use one or combine them. Whichever you pick, you see it working with your business first.

webs.title: Websites with motion
webs.description: Landing pages and sites that move, load fast and explain your business in seconds.
webs.result: People message you on WhatsApp in one tap, right from their phone.

systems.title: Booking and ordering systems
systems.description: Online calendar, automatic confirmations and orders that arrive organized.
systems.result: Customers book and order on their own, at any hour.

voice.title: AI voice agents
voice.description: A natural voice that answers the phone, handles the usual questions and books appointments.

chat.title: Chatbots and automations
chat.description: Instant replies on WhatsApp and on your website. Reminders and follow-ups that go out on their own.
chat.result: Every inquiry gets an answer in seconds, and you get the customer ready to buy.

commerce.title: E-commerce
commerce.description: Catalog, cart, payments and shipping, with your brand's identity.
commerce.result: You sell around the clock, even when the store is closed.

apps.title: Apps and platforms
apps.description: Your service in your own app: bookings, orders and payments, with a dashboard to run it.
apps.result: Customers book, order and pay from your own app.

process.title: First you see your demo. Then we talk.
process.sub: That's how we sell: within {hours} hours we build a demo of your business, before any call. If you like it, we keep going.

demo.title: A demo of your business
demo.body: With your name, your industry and your services. We send it on WhatsApp and you try it before any call.

call.title: Call and proposal
call.body: We talk through what you saw and send you a written proposal: scope, price and timeline.

build.title: Deposit and build
build.body: The deposit gets us started. We build on the demo you already approved, and you see every step.

launch.title: Launch and training
launch.body: We put it live, make sure it works and show you and your team how to use it.

care.title: Maintenance and upgrades
care.body: Hosting, backups and changes every month. Your system grows with your business.
